checks: Saving a dirty settings field preserves concurrently refreshed port, token and proxy; inactive retention control is hidden
Canceled import keeps unsaved settings and export write failures stay visible
Group saves lock editing and closing, display validation errors, and preserve the draft for one explicit retry
Group deletion failures remain visible and toggling sends only the enabled field
Supplier model fetch locks the editor, preserves the saved ID after RPC rejection, and retries update that supplier
Supplier delete and save errors are caught and remain in the relevant page or editor
Model apply carries the exact reviewed selection and revision; stale catalog rejection requires a fresh preview
Membership group failure disables adding; successful addition followed by failed model sync still advances without creating duplicates
Usage distinguishes an unpriced request from a confirmed free request and labels the partial estimate
A request-log failure does not discard successfully loaded usage totals, and a later refresh recovers
scope: Real React components, controlled IPC and deferred failures; no client files or paid accounts
